objective: Canary execution proving isolated non-LLM worker and reviewer handlers under the VIA Score conductor.
constraints: Isolated canary lane execution only (score-canary-lane); no release lane access.
Fixed non-LLM handler execution only; no LLM dispatch.
Deterministic evidence written only under score-runs/{run_id}/.
Strict separation of duty: work and review roles must differ, and author cannot review own work.
No SSM command execution, deploy Lambda invocation, kms:Sign, schedule-data mutation, or IAM changes.

tasks.title: Deterministic canary artifact generation and independent hash verification
tasks.instructions: Execute fixed non-LLM worker to write a deterministic JSON artifact under score-runs/{run_id}/ and return its path and sha256; independently fetch and verify exact bytes and author/reviewer segregation.
